facts.fact: ICASEES published its Education Annuaire Statistique 2023-2024 (198 pages, imprint September 2025), a school census yearbook compiled from school questionnaires across 20 inspectorates.
The ICASEES Education yearbook 2023-2024 draws on school questionnaires returned by schools across 20 inspectorates.

The ICASEES site lists a workshop analysing the results of the light pilot census (RPA) of the RGPH-4, dated 25 July 2025, and a March 2025 test of enumerator candidates for the next phase on tablets.

CAF.note: The document states no data exchange between education systems.
The page body names no EMIS; the SIGE restoration appears only in a catalogue line, not as a stated build or pilot.
A census yearbook from paper questionnaires is census class, noted and not assessed.
